purpose: Encourage curiosity, competence, agency and lifelong learning through evidence-based educational games.

principles.rule: Reward demonstrated understanding and improvement, not screen time or purchases.
Offer meaningful choice of subjects, challenges, pace, and accessible 2D or optional VR experiences.
Explain why an answer is right or wrong, allow low-stakes retries and recommend a next learning step.
Avoid addictive streak pressure, manipulative rewards, public rankings of children and punitive failure messaging.
Provide keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion and non-VR alternatives for required learning.
Keep source references, educator review status and academic recognition claims truthful.
Do not require identifying student information for prototype practice; secure student records before formal enrollment.

progression.practice: Stars and feedback for formative learning only
progression.mastery: Use multiple independent demonstrations of understanding before marking a topic mastered
progression.formalAssessment: Instructor-approved, authenticated, auditable grading system required before official credit
